cases.name: unknown-child-of-sequence
cases.description: An invented tag inside <sequence>. It used to validate and run: check said "is valid", exit 0, and the tag did nothing. <env> has always answered this.

cases.name: unknown-child-of-switch
cases.description: Self-closing on purpose: the walk skipped anything that was not an open/close element, so this exact spelling passed while <bogus></bogus> was caught.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="p" local="en"><sequence name="K"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><switch name="S" on="K"><bogus_tag/><case is="a"><data>1</data></case><default><data>2</data></default></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: unknown-child-of-distinct
cases.description: A <distinct> wrapper inside a sequence groups <gen>s; its own body was never looked at.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="p" local="en"><sequence name="A"><distinct><gen name="p" type="number" value="1..9"/><gen name="q" type="number" value="1..9"/><bogus_tag/></distinct></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: unknown-child-of-pool
cases.description: Same skip as <switch>: neither branch of the pool member loop said anything about a name it did not know.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="p" local="en"><pool name="P" count="3"><bogus_tag/><sequence name="f"><gen type="text" value="x,y,z"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: unknown-child-of-fixture
cases.description: A fixture holds text and <line>s. Anything else was ignored unless it was a generator inside a <line>.

cases.name: unknown-child-of-block
cases.description: A <block> holds <line>s. Rust accepted an invented tag here in silence — a hole left when the other containers were closed, and one the full report hid: it only showed when the brief output put the implementations on one line each.
